resources.string: U-%1$s uvunyelwe ishifu yakho kuze kube ngu-%2$s. Akudingeki ikhodi entsha inqobo nje uma lokhu kuvuma kusasebenza.
Faka wonke amadijithi ayisithupha, kuhlanganise nezinombolo zero zokuqala.
Hlola igama ledivayisi ye-PulseLink nomtholampilo esikrinini sangempela. Ukuvuma kuvumela lesi sikrini ukuthi sisebenzise izimvume zakho zomhlengikazi ishifu yamahora ayisishiyagalombili.
Ukuvuma kunqatshiwe. Hlola ikhodi yesikrini nesiza sakho sokwabelwa komhlengikazi.
Ikhodi iphelelwe yisikhathi noma ikhiyiwe. Cela ikhodi entsha esikrinini sokuthinta.
Ukuvuma kushintshile noma omunye umhlengikazi uvume lesi sikrini. Cela ikhodi entsha.
Impendulo yokuvuma ayifani nalo mhlengikazi, idivayisi nesiza. Vuselela ukufinyelela bese uzama futhi.
